title: 直接粘贴为纯文本功能导致键盘按键粘连

author_wait_evidence.author: github-actions
author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Translate the issue title and description to English, update from 0.100.2 to the latest stable release 0.101.2362.0, and confirm whether the issue still reproduces.

judgment.rationale: The report describes repeated Advanced Paste plain-text use leaving Alt logically down, but the current issue is already awaiting translation and a latest-stable retest. Do not repeat that request or infer a fix before the scope is readable.
evidence: The reporter states PowerToys 0.100.2 and says repeated Alt+V plain-text pastes leave Alt held until pressed again.
The reporter says the same occurs when activating through a mouse side-button binding, arguing against a faulty physical Alt key.

The github-actions triage comment at https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/51445#issuecomment-6308273395 requests an English translation and confirmation on the latest stable release; no author response is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the already-requested translation and current-build confirmation, then re-triage the exact activation sequence.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys fix cannot be scoped from the untranslated, one-sentence repro before the existing request for a translation and current-build result is answered.

issue_context.summary: The reporter reports an Alt key that remains logically pressed after repeated Advanced Paste plain-text activations; the issue's existing triage request has not yet been answered.
known_information: The report names Advanced Paste plain-text paste and the Alt+V shortcut on PowerToys 0.100.2.
The reporter says a mouse side-button activation produces the same symptom, and manually pressing Alt releases it.
The triage bot requested an English translation and a latest-stable retest; the thread contains no later author reply.
inferences: A missing or mismatched modifier key-up in the activation or paste path is possible, but the reported text alone does not identify which component owns the event.
issue_context.analysis: The exact user sequence, expected result, and whether the defect survives a current build remain unclear. The existing author request is the right discriminator; issuing another request would duplicate it.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and all one comment; labels are Issue-Bug, Needs-Author-Feedback, Needs-Triage, and Product-Advanced Paste.
The focused Advanced Paste UI tests exercise paste-as-plain-text through configured activation shortcuts, but do not establish this reporter's modifier-up failure.

information_gaps.information: An English translation of the exact activation and paste sequence and whether it still reproduces on the latest stable build.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the observed stuck modifier is current and whether it occurs with the configured shortcut, the mouse binding, or both.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply to the existing triage comment with the translation and numbered steps, then confirm the latest stable version tested.
